notes: Three shaykhs open one level («- واللفظ لعمرو -» is an editor gloss and is left out); «قال عمرو وقتيبة حدثنا وقال، إسحاق أخبرنا» repeats them with other verbs and is read as the same level, not as extra routes
Jabir is the last link: the Prophet's words («قال لي رسول الله») are his own report
